notes: The entire EHI export documentation is a single 1-page PDF. No data dictionary, no schema, no field-level documentation exists. The only structured information provided is that the export contains two components: C-CDA documents and CSV files for demographics and appointments. No field names, types, descriptions, or relationships are documented anywhere.

entities.name: C-CDA Document
entities.description: Each patient will have a C-CDA document in the exported data.
entities.notes: No specification of which C-CDA document type (CCD, Continuity of Care Document, etc.), which template versions, or which sections are populated. C-CDA is a standard that can include problems, medications, allergies, immunizations, vitals, procedures, lab results, and clinical notes, but the vendor does not indicate which sections their implementation includes.
